title: The Tidal Archive
source: Mara keeps the harbor archive. Ilan repairs its flooded shelves. At noon Mara accuses Ilan of selling a brass ledger, but she has no evidence. Ilan says he moved it above the tide line. Mara cannot open the upper room because only the retired keeper has its key. A red scarf hangs on a chair; nobody refers to it again. The chapter ends before anyone enters the upper room.
required: Only the retired keeper has the upper-room key.
belief: Mara suspects Ilan sold the ledger; this is an unproven accusation.
update: Accepted revision: the retired keeper gives Mara the upper-room key at dusk. The ledger has not yet been found.
new_state: Mara now has the upper-room key; the ledger's location remains unresolved.
revision:
Mara opened the door.
The harbor bell rang twice.

title: The Glass Orchard
source: Suri tends glass trees that grow only under recorded birdsong. Aven maintains the recorder and cannot hear high notes after an accident. When one tree cracks, Suri wonders whether Aven damaged its song. Aven has not confessed and no test has been run. The original recording is sealed in the municipal vault. Three empty cups sit beside the workbench. The scene ends with Suri asking permission to inspect the vault.
required: The original recording is sealed in the municipal vault.
belief: Suri suspects a damaged song; Aven's responsibility is unknown.
optional: Aven cannot hear high notes after an accident.
update: Accepted revision: Suri receives permission to inspect the vault tomorrow. The recorder has not been tested.
new_state: Suri may inspect the vault tomorrow; the cause of the crack remains unknown.
revision:
Suri touched the branch.
The recorder kept turning.

title: The Night Ferry
source: Oren is a ferry clerk. Leda boards with an unsigned ticket and asks him not to announce her destination. Oren thinks she is fleeing a creditor, but she has not told him why she is traveling. The ferry will stop at Bell Quay before continuing to the island. Only the captain knows the revised sailing time. A chipped blue plate rolls under a bench. Leda waits by the gangway while Oren decides whether to call the captain.
required: The captain alone knows the revised sailing time.
belief: Oren's creditor explanation is a guess, not Leda's stated motive.
optional: Bell Quay is the first stop.
incidental: The plate is chipped and blue.
update: Accepted revision: the captain tells Oren the ferry departs at midnight. Leda's motive stays private.
new_state: Oren knows the midnight departure; he still does not know Leda's motive.
forbidden: Leda admits she is fleeing a creditor.
revision:
Oren lifted the ticket.
The rope scraped against the rail.
protected: The rope scraped against the rail.

title: Winter Radio
source: Nessa runs a mountain radio station with her brother Tomas. A rescue signal arrives on a frequency missing from their log. Tomas says their mother once used that channel, but he is remembering a childhood visit and may be mistaken. Nessa has never heard the voice before. The antenna cannot be turned until the ice thaws. There are five pencils in a mug. They agree to record the next transmission rather than answer it immediately.
required: The antenna cannot be turned until the ice thaws.
belief: Tomas's memory of their mother's channel is uncertain.
optional: They agreed to record the next transmission before replying.
incidental: Five pencils are in the mug.
update: Accepted revision: the ice thaws and Nessa turns the antenna east. Nobody identifies the voice.
new_state: The antenna points east; the voice is still unidentified.
revision:
Nessa reached for the dial.
Static filled the room.

title: The Copper Trial
source: Dara records testimony at a provincial court. Sen claims a copper seal was copied, but the expert has examined only a drawing. Dara knows the original seal remains in a locked evidence chest. The judge has prohibited discussion of the witness's family outside court. A clerk spills sand on the back steps. The hearing pauses before the chest can be opened. No verdict has been given.
required: The original seal remains in a locked evidence chest.
belief: Sen alleges copying; the expert has seen only a drawing.
optional: The witness's family must not be discussed outside court.
incidental: A clerk spilled sand on the steps.
update: Accepted revision: the chest is opened in court and the original seal is placed on the bench. Examination is still pending.
new_state: The seal is on the bench; authenticity has not been decided.
forbidden: The court finds the seal counterfeit.
revision:
Dara set down her pen.
The judge called for silence.

title: The Last Cinema
source: Emil cleans a cinema scheduled to close on Friday. Ruth finds an unlabeled reel and says it may show the old neighborhood festival. She has seen only its first damaged frame. Emil promised the owner that nothing would be screened without checking the projector. A green umbrella lies in the aisle. The reel is stored in the projection booth overnight. Nobody has watched the full film.
required: The projector must be checked before anything is screened.
optional: The cinema is scheduled to close on Friday.
update: Accepted revision: a technician checks the projector and declares it safe. The reel has not been screened.
new_state: The projector is safe; the reel's contents remain unknown.
forbidden: The film definitely shows the festival.
revision:
Emil picked up the reel.
A seat folded shut behind him.
protected: A seat folded shut behind him.

title: The Salt Garden
source: Yara allocates water in a communal garden. Belen finds a buried clay jar and believes it marks an old well. No map or excavation confirms this. Yara must reserve two barrels for seedlings under an agreement with the growers. A dog sleeps against the west wall. The council will discuss digging after the morning inspection. Until then, the jar stays where it was found.
required: Two water barrels are reserved for seedlings.
optional: The council discusses digging after the morning inspection.
incidental: A dog sleeps against the west wall.
update: Accepted revision: the council permits a shallow test trench after inspection. The seedling reserve remains unchanged.
new_state: A shallow test trench is permitted; two barrels remain reserved for seedlings.
forbidden: They empty the seedling reserve to wash the jar.
revision:
Yara knelt beside the jar.
Dust settled on the leaves.
prose_style: sensory description grounded in physical detail

title: The Paper Border
source: Kavi copies boundary maps. Noor brings a folded survey that places her house on both sides of the border. The surveyor's signature is missing. Kavi thinks a copying error caused the overlap, but the archive has not been checked. Only the supervisor can authorize a corrected official copy. A yellow stamp pad has dried out. Noor leaves her map for inspection and keeps her existing residence papers.
required: Only the supervisor can authorize a corrected official copy.
belief: Kavi suspects a copying error; the cause has not been established.
optional: Noor retains her existing residence papers.
incidental: The stamp pad is yellow and dry.
update: Accepted revision: the supervisor authorizes a provisional correction pending an archive check. Noor keeps her papers.
new_state: A provisional correction is authorized; the archive check is still pending.
revision:
Kavi unfolded the map.
The queue moved one step forward.
protected: The queue moved one step forward.

title: The Hollow Clock
source: Pia inherits a watch that stops whenever Ren enters the workshop. Ren says the spring was replaced last winter, though the repair book has a missing page. Pia suspects a trick and has no proof. The watch cannot be opened without its uncommon square key, held by a collector. A white moth rests on the window. Pia agrees to write down the stopping times before drawing conclusions.
required: A collector holds the square key needed to open the watch.
belief: Pia suspects a trick; neither mechanism nor intent is established.
optional: Pia agreed to record stopping times before drawing conclusions.
incidental: A white moth rests on the window.
update: Accepted revision: the collector lends Pia the square key. She has not opened the watch yet.
new_state: Pia has the key on loan; the watch's mechanism is still unexamined.
forbidden: Ren confesses to sabotaging the watch.
revision:
Pia laid the watch on the cloth.
The wall clock struck six.

title: The Blue Kitchen
source: Ada and Milo run their aunt's restaurant for a week. Milo finds a recipe card and thinks the crossed-out ingredient is the secret to her soup. Their aunt has not confirmed this and is away until Sunday. Ada promised not to serve untested dishes to paying guests. A spoon lies under the freezer. They agree to make a small test batch after closing and keep the regular menu tomorrow.
required: Untested dishes must not be served to paying guests.
belief: Milo's interpretation of the crossed-out ingredient is speculative.
optional: They will keep the regular menu tomorrow.
incidental: A spoon lies under the freezer.
update: Accepted revision: the test batch tastes good to Ada and Milo, but no menu change has been authorized.
new_state: The batch has been tasted privately; tomorrow's regular menu is unchanged.
forbidden: They replace tomorrow's menu without agreement.
revision:
Ada turned over the recipe card.
The extractor fan clicked off.
